article.title: Organisation of village panchayats
article.content: The State shall take steps to organise village panchayats and endow them with such powers and authority as may be necessary to enable them to function as units of self-government.
article.html:
40Organisation of village panchayats

Article 40 · Part IV

The State shall take steps to organise village panchayats and endow them with such powers and authority as may be necessary to enable them to function as units of self-government.
